venue.name: Flying Squirrel Trampoline Park
venue.description: Flying Squirrel Trampoline Park is an indoor trampoline and adventure park at 808 Viewfield Road in Victoria, with trampoline courts, a ropes course, a Kiddie Court reserved for ages 6 and younger, an arcade and the Drey Cafe. Activities are free play: Court Monitors supervise every court but do not teach or guide guests. Drop-in jump time is sold by the hour ($25 for 60 minutes at the standard rate, $15 for children 6 and under), trampoline grip socks and a signed waiver are required for everyone who goes on the trampolines, and no outside food or drink is allowed. The park takes group bookings and private facility buyouts for school field trips and youth groups, quoted case by case, and runs supervised full-day summer camps for ages 6 to 12.

facility_notes.lunch_space: We typically do not offer a table for group events as tables are reserved for party package bookings. However, for larger group bookings, please contact our Director of Sales.
facility_notes.rain_backup: Our large indoor park means rain or shine, camp runs every day.

restrictions: We ask that no outside food or beverage is brought into our facility.
Trampoline grip socks are required due to safety and sanitary concerns.
All participants who are jumping or going onto the trampolines, regardless of age, require a waiver. Minors (under 18) must have a parent or guardian sign the waiver for them.
We do not allow guests to jump while wearing a cast.
The Ropes Course requires climbers to be 6+ years and 4'1" to go with an adult, 8+ years and 4'5" to go unaccompanied.
People of all ages are welcome to jump as long as they can walk confidently unassisted.
venue.hours_notes: Sunday - Thursday: 10am - 7pm; Friday - Saturday: 10am - 11pm. Ropes Course Saturday/Sunday: 10am - 5pm. Neon Lights runs Friday and Saturday 9pm to 11pm and is a dark, loud environment.

programs.name: Group Event or Facility Buyout
programs.description: A booked group event or private buyout of the trampoline park, offered for school field trips, homeschool groups, youth groups, sports teams, summer camps and corporate events. The Victoria home page advertises groups of 20 to 300 while the group buyouts page speaks of groups from 25 to 1,000. No group price is published: the site says group rates and incentives exist and directs bookings to the Director of Sales or the group form. A deposit equal to 50% of the total event cost is required to secure a booking. Tables are not normally included for group events and no outside food or drink may be brought in.
programs.what_children_do: Children jump on the trampoline courts, use the foam pits, dodgeball courts, climbing walls and other attractions at their own pace; staff monitor each court for safety but do not run activities, so the visit is free play from start to finish.
programs.our_note: There is no published group price and nothing is instructor-led, so this is a run-around-and-jump outing rather than a programmed one - budget for a quote and for grip socks on top. Outside food is not allowed and group bookings do not normally get a table, so plan lunch off site or ask the sales contact to add one.
programs.practical_summary: Fully indoors, so weather is not a factor, and everything runs as free play with court monitors watching. There is no published price, no table for lunch unless you ask, and the site says nothing about washrooms, bus parking or wheelchair access - all worth confirming when you request a quote.
programs.extra_fees_note: Trampoline grip socks are not included in admission. Tables are not typically offered for group events.
programs.payment_timing: We require a deposit equal to 50% of the total event cost to secure your booking.
programs.cancellation_note: If you cancel your party or event more than 2 weeks (14 FULL DAYS) before the date it is scheduled for, we can refund your deposit entirely. If you cancel within 2 weeks we cannot refund the deposit, but the event can be rescheduled up to 1 year with no additional penalty.
programs.evidence: Bring your group of 20-300 for an action-packed excursion that they'll be talking about for weeks!

programs.name: Toddler Jump Time (ages 6 and under)
programs.description: Timed drop-in jump time at the toddler rate for children 6 years of age and under: $15 for one hour, $20 for 90 minutes and $25 for 120 minutes. The rate is available during all operating hours but not during Neon Lights. A Kiddie Court is reserved for ages 6 and younger, though children may also use the rest of the facility. Children 2 and under jump free with a paying adult. Adults who only watch are not charged, and a free Parent wristband lets an adult go onto the trampolines to help a small child without jumping; grip socks and a waiver are still required for that adult. Tickets should be booked online ahead of the visit.
programs.what_children_do: Small children bounce on the Kiddie Court set aside for ages 6 and under, in grip socks, for a booked hour, and can also go out onto the main trampoline courts, foam pits and other attractions.
programs.our_note: Nothing here is led or taught - court monitors watch for safety only - so an adult needs to be on the trampolines with the youngest children. The free Parent wristband still needs a waiver and grip socks, so factor a pair per accompanying adult into the cost, and note the park bans outside food.
programs.practical_summary: Indoors and weather-proof, with a court reserved for the under-sixes and no charge for adults who stay off the trampolines. Washrooms, change space and stroller or wheelchair access are not mentioned anywhere on the site, and outside food is not allowed - ask before you go.
programs.extra_fees_note: Trampoline grip socks are not included in admission.
programs.payment_timing: Full payment is required when the ticket is reserved.
programs.cancellation_note: NO REFUNDS * ALL SALES ARE FINAL
programs.evidence: $15 for one hour of jump time.

programs.name: Summer Day Camp (ages 6 to 12)
programs.description: A supervised full-day summer day camp for children aged 6 to 12, grouped as ages 6-8 and 9-12, running Monday to Friday across ten weeks from 29 June to 4 September 2026. The day mixes two structured trampoline sessions with obstacle courses, team games, arts, crafts and LEGO building, calm blocks and a themed activity; jumping is deliberately limited to two sessions to prevent fatigue. Staff are trained in First Aid and CPR and work under a Camp Director. 2026 fees are $449.99 for a five-day week and $399.99 for a four-day week. Early drop-off from 8:00 AM and late pick-up are available for a surcharge. Children bring a nut-free lunch, two snacks, a water bottle, athletic clothing and grip socks.
programs.what_children_do: Children arrive for a morning circle, do two supervised trampoline sessions with jumping games and foam pits, run obstacle courses and scavenger hunts, make things in a craft and LEGO block, eat a packed lunch, and wind down with yoga, board games or parachute play before wrap-up games.
programs.our_note: Jumping is capped at two sessions a day, which is the sensible answer to a whole day in a trampoline park - the rest is craft, games and quiet blocks. Registration is per child through the park's online store rather than a group booking, and the site says weeks sell out well in advance.
programs.practical_summary: Indoors and running rain or shine, with first-aid trained staff, age-split groups and children bringing their own nut-free lunch. The site does not state washrooms, staff-to-child ratios or a cancellation policy for camp, and it gives two different camp start times - confirm the daily schedule when you register.
programs.extra_fees_note: Short weeks of 4-day summer camps are $399.99. Early drop off and late pick-up are available for a surcharge. Grip socks are available at the park if needed.
programs.evidence: Long Weeks of 5-day summer camps are : $449.99
